type: ∀ {x y : Rat}, StatFused.IsInd x → StatFused.IsInd y → StatFused.IsInd (x * y)

name: StatFused.Ex_const

type: ∀ (x w : Rat) (e : StatFused.Dist), StatFused.mass (StatFused.shift x w e) = w * StatFused.mass e

name: StatFused.or_table
type: MultAdd.wAdd (-1) 0 0 = 0 ∧ MultAdd.wAdd (-1) 0 1 = 1 ∧ MultAdd.wAdd (-1) 1 0 = 1 ∧ MultAdd.wAdd (-1) 1 1 = 1

name: StatFused.m4_conv
type:
∀ (d e : StatFused.Dist),
  StatFused.m4 (StatFused.conv d e) =
    StatFused.m4 d * StatFused.mass e + 4 * StatFused.m3 d * StatFused.m1 e + 6 * StatFused.m2 d * StatFused.m2 e +
        4 * StatFused.m1 d * StatFused.m3 e +
      StatFused.mass d * StatFused.m4 e

name: StatFused.gen_neg_one
type: ∀ (d : StatFused.NDist), StatFused.gen d (-1) = StatFused.pEven d - StatFused.pOdd d

name: StatFused.clt_kurt
type:
∀ (d : StatFused.Dist),
  StatFused.mass d = 1 →
    ∀ (n : Nat), 0 < n → StatFused.k2 d ≠ 0 → StatFused.kurt (StatFused.convPow d n) * ↑n = StatFused.kurt d

name: StatFused.kmoment_law
type:
∀ (k a b : Rat) (d e : StatFused.NDist),
  1 + k * a = StatFused.gen d (1 + k) →
    1 + k * b = StatFused.gen e (1 + k) → 1 + k * MultAdd.wAdd k a b = StatFused.gen (StatFused.nconv d e) (1 + k)

name: StatFused.heads_parity
type: ∀ (ps : List Rat), StatFused.gen (StatFused.heads ps) (-1) = 1 - 2 * StatFused.foldW (-2) ps

name: StatFused.cov_is_corner_excess

side.name: (StatFused.Ex ws fun a => A a * B a) - StatFused.Ex ws A * StatFused.Ex ws B

type:
∀ {α : Type} (ws : List (α × Rat)) (A B : α → Rat) (lift : Rat),
  (StatFused.Ex ws fun a => A a * B a) = lift * StatFused.Ex ws A * StatFused.Ex ws B →
    (StatFused.Ex ws fun a => A a * B a) - StatFused.Ex ws A * StatFused.Ex ws B =
      (lift - 1) * StatFused.Ex ws A * StatFused.Ex ws B

name: StatFused.bayes_odds
type:
∀ (p lH lN : Rat),

    p ≠ 1 →
      lH ≠ 0 →
        lN ≠ 0 →
          p * lH + (1 - p) * lN ≠ 0 → StatFused.odds (p * lH / (p * lH + (1 - p) * lN)) = StatFused.odds p * (lH / lN)

name: StatFused.binom_kmoment
type: ∀ (k p : Rat) (n : Nat), StatFused.gen (StatFused.binom p n) (1 + k) = 1 + k * MultAdd.wpow k p n

name: StatFused.heads_kmoment
type: ∀ (k : Rat) (ps : List Rat), StatFused.gen (StatFused.heads ps) (1 + k) = 1 + k * StatFused.foldW k ps

name: StatFused.gen_is_lit_corners
type: ∀ (d : StatFused.NDist) (k : Rat), StatFused.gen d (1 + k) = StatFused.litCorners d k

name: StatFused.not_ind
type: ∀ {x : Rat}, StatFused.IsInd x → StatFused.IsInd (1 - x)

type: ∀ (d : StatFused.Dist), StatFused.mass d = 1 → ∀ (n : Nat), StatFused.k2 (StatFused.convPow d n) = ↑n * StatFused.k2 d

name: StatFused.bern_kmoment
type: ∀ (k p : Rat), StatFused.gen (StatFused.nbern p) (1 + k) = 1 + k * p

name: StatFused.bp_above

name: StatFused.gen_zero
type: ∀ (d : StatFused.NDist), StatFused.gen d 0 = StatFused.pZero d

MultAdd.sumL (List.map (fun g => StatFused.Ex ws (F g)) gs)

type:
∀ {α β : Type} (ws : List (α × Rat)) (gs : List β) (F : β → α → Rat),
  (StatFused.Ex ws fun a => MultAdd.sumL (List.map (fun g => F g a) gs)) =
    MultAdd.sumL (List.map (fun g => StatFused.Ex ws (F g)) gs)

name: StatFused.prodL_neg_sgn
type: ∀ (g : List Rat), MultAdd.prodL (List.map (fun x => -x) g) = StatFused.sgn g * MultAdd.prodL g

name: StatFused.repeated_evidence
type: ∀ (o l : Rat) (n : Nat), o * l ^ n - 1 = MultAdd.multAdd (o - 1) (MultAdd.mpow (l - 1) n)

type: ∀ (p : Rat), p ≠ 0 → p ≠ 1 → MultAdd.multAdd (StatFused.odds p - 1) (StatFused.odds (1 - p) - 1) = 0

name: StatFused.union_neg_foldMA
type: ∀ (l : List Rat), StatFused.unionL l = -MultAdd.foldMA (List.map (fun x => -x) l)

name: StatFused.amh_lens_multiplies

sides.name: 1 - θ * StatFused.lens (-(1 + θ)) θ a b

type:
∀ (θ a b : Rat),
  1 - θ * a * b ≠ 0 →
    (1 - StatFused.lens (-(1 + θ)) θ a b) * ((1 - θ * a) * (1 - θ * b)) =
      (1 - a) * (1 - b) * (1 - θ * StatFused.lens (-(1 + θ)) θ a b)

name: StatFused.m2_conv
type:
∀ (d e : StatFused.Dist),
  StatFused.m2 (StatFused.conv d e) =
    StatFused.m2 d * StatFused.mass e + 2 * StatFused.m1 d * StatFused.m1 e + StatFused.mass d * StatFused.m2 e

name: StatFused.m3_shift

sides.name: x * x * x * StatFused.mass e + 3 * (x * x) * StatFused.m1 e + 3 * x * StatFused.m2 e + StatFused.m3 e

type:
∀ (x w : Rat) (e : StatFused.Dist),
  StatFused.m3 (StatFused.shift x w e) =
    w * (x * x * x * StatFused.mass e + 3 * (x * x) * StatFused.m1 e + 3 * x * StatFused.m2 e + StatFused.m3 e)

type:
∀ (d e : StatFused.Dist),

name: StatFused.complement_is_inverse
type: ∀ (p : Rat), p ≠ 0 → p ≠ 1 → StatFused.odds (1 - p) - 1 = MultAdd.multAddInv (StatFused.odds p - 1)

name: StatFused.scale_m

∀ (c : Rat) (d : StatFused.Dist),
  StatFused.mass (StatFused.scale c d) = StatFused.mass d ∧
    StatFused.m1 (StatFused.scale c d) = c * StatFused.m1 d ∧
      StatFused.m2 (StatFused.scale c d) = c * c * StatFused.m2 d ∧
        StatFused.m3 (StatFused.scale c d) = c * c * c * StatFused.m3 d ∧
          StatFused.m4 (StatFused.scale c d) = c * c * c * c * StatFused.m4 d

name: StatFused.amh_independent
type: ∀ (a b : Rat), StatFused.lens (-(1 + 0)) 0 a b = MultAdd.wAdd (-1) a b

name: StatFused.heads_none
type: ∀ (ps : List Rat), StatFused.gen (StatFused.heads ps) 0 = 1 - StatFused.foldW (-1) ps

name: StatFused.amh_zero
type: ∀ (u v : Rat), StatFused.amh 0 u v = u * v

name: StatFused.sq_diff_is_xor
type: ∀ {x y : Rat}, StatFused.IsInd x → StatFused.IsInd y → (x - y) * (x - y) = MultAdd.wAdd (-2) x y

name: StatFused.clt_skew
type:
∀ (d : StatFused.Dist),
  StatFused.mass d = 1 →
    ∀ (n : Nat), 0 < n → StatFused.k2 d ≠ 0 → StatFused.skewSq (StatFused.convPow d n) * ↑n = StatFused.skewSq d

name: StatFused.m4_append
type: ∀ (d e : StatFused.Dist), StatFused.m4 (d ++ e) = StatFused.m4 d + StatFused.m4 e

∀ (c : Rat) (d : StatFused.Dist),
  StatFused.k2 (StatFused.scale c d) = c ^ 2 * StatFused.k2 d ∧
    StatFused.k3 (StatFused.scale c d) = c ^ 3 * StatFused.k3 d ∧
      StatFused.k4 (StatFused.scale c d) = c ^ 4 * StatFused.k4 d

name: StatFused.kurt_scale

∀ {α : Type} (ws : List (α × Rat)) (A B : α → Rat) (lift : Rat),

type: ∀ {α β : Type} (f : α → β) (l : List α), MultAdd.groups (List.map f l) = List.map (List.map f) (MultAdd.groups l)

type: ∀ (x y : Rat), MultAdd.wAdd (-2) (1 - x) (1 - y) = MultAdd.wAdd (-2) x y

StatFused.Ex ws A + StatFused.Ex ws B - StatFused.Ex ws fun a => A a * B a

∀ {α : Type} (ws : List (α × Rat)) (A B : α → Rat),

sides.name:
x * x * x * x * StatFused.mass e + 4 * (x * x * x) * StatFused.m1 e + 6 * (x * x) * StatFused.m2 e +

  StatFused.m4 e

∀ (x w : Rat) (e : StatFused.Dist),

    w *
      (x * x * x * x * StatFused.mass e + 4 * (x * x * x) * StatFused.m1 e + 6 * (x * x) * StatFused.m2 e +

∀ (d e : StatFused.Dist),
  StatFused.m3 (StatFused.conv d e) =
    StatFused.m3 d * StatFused.mass e + 3 * StatFused.m2 d * StatFused.m1 e + 3 * StatFused.m1 d * StatFused.m2 e +

name: StatFused.bern_stats

∀ (p : Rat),
  StatFused.mass (StatFused.bern p) = 1 ∧
    StatFused.m1 (StatFused.bern p) = p ∧
      StatFused.k2 (StatFused.bern p) = p * (1 - p) ∧
        StatFused.k3 (StatFused.bern p) = p * (1 - p) * (1 - 2 * p) ∧
          StatFused.k4 (StatFused.bern p) = p * (1 - p) * (1 - 6 * p + 6 * p * p)

type: ∀ {x y : Rat}, StatFused.IsInd x → StatFused.IsInd y → StatFused.IsInd (MultAdd.wAdd (-1) x y)

MultAdd.sumL (List.map (fun g => StatFused.sgn g * StatFused.Ex ws (StatFused.allOf g)) (MultAdd.groups As))

side.name: 1 - B * NeuroScience.lens (-(A + B)) (A * B) a b

  1 - A * B * a * b ≠ 0 →

name: NeuroScience.twoport_lens

side.name: NeuroScience.lens (-(Zij / (Ej * Zsi) + Zij / (Ei * Zsj))) (Zij ^ 2 / (Ei * Ej * Zsi * Zsj)) (Zsi * I1) (Zsj * J2)

type:
∀ {K : Type} [inst : Grind.Field K] (Zsi Zsj Zii Zjj Zij gi gj Ei Ej I1 J2 I J : K),
  I1 * (1 + gi * Zii) = gi * Ei →
    J2 * (1 + gj * Zjj) = gj * Ej →
      I * (1 + gi * Zii) + gi * Zij * J = gi * Ei →
        J * (1 + gj * Zjj) + gj * Zij * I = gj * Ej →
          Ei ≠ 0 →
            Ej ≠ 0 →
              Zsi ≠ 0 →
                Zsj ≠ 0 →
                  Ei * Ej - Zij ^ 2 * I1 * J2 ≠ 0 →
                    Zsi * I + Zsj * J =
                      NeuroScience.lens (-(Zij / (Ej * Zsi) + Zij / (Ei * Zsj))) (Zij ^ 2 / (Ei * Ej * Zsi * Zsj))
                        (Zsi * I1) (Zsj * J2)

∀ {K : Type} [inst : Grind.Field K] (A B a b : K),

name: NeuroScience.twoport

side.name: Ei * Ej * (Zsi * I1 + Zsj * J2) - Zij * (Ei * Zsj + Ej * Zsi) * I1 * J2

type:
∀ {R : Type} [inst : Grind.CommRing R] (Zsi Zsj Zii Zjj Zij gi gj Ei Ej I1 J2 I J : R),
  I1 * (1 + gi * Zii) = gi * Ei →
    J2 * (1 + gj * Zjj) = gj * Ej →
      I * (1 + gi * Zii) + gi * Zij * J = gi * Ei →
        J * (1 + gj * Zjj) + gj * Zij * I = gj * Ej →
          (Zsi * I + Zsj * J) * (Ei * Ej - Zij ^ 2 * I1 * J2) =
            Ei * Ej * (Zsi * I1 + Zsj * J2) - Zij * (Ei * Zsj + Ej * Zsi) * I1 * J2

name: NeuroScience.T_mul

1 - B * NeuroScience.lens (-(A + B)) (A * B) a b

type:

name: FractionalPowerset.flat_mul_flat_add
type:
∀ {C : Type} (add mul : C → C → C) (le : C → C → Prop),
  (∀ (a b : C), le a b → le b a → a = b) →
    ∀ (two : C),
      (∀ (m : C), mul m two = add m m) →
        (∀ (m a b : C), le a b → le (mul m a) (mul m b)) →
          (∀ (a b : C), le a (add a b)) → ∀ (m : C), le two m → mul m m = m → add m m = m

name: FractionalPowerset.dial_inflationary

    (∀ (k x : Nat), F (k + 1) (F (k + 1) x) = F k x) → (∀ (x : Nat), x < F 0 x) → ∀ (k x : Nat), x < F k x

name: FractionalPowerset.no_descending_wf

name: FractionalPowerset.no_monotone_half_pow2

name: FractionalPowerset.flat_add_flat_succ
type:
∀ {C : Type} (add : C → C → C) (le : C → C → Prop),
  (∀ (a b : C), le a b → le b a → a = b) →
    ∀ (one : C),
      (∀ (m a b : C), le a b → le (add m a) (add m b)) →
        (∀ (a b : C), le a (add a b)) → ∀ (m : C), le one m → add m m = m → add m one = m

name: FractionalPowerset.no_dyadic_dial

∀ (F : Nat → Nat → Nat),
  (∀ (k x y : Nat), x ≤ y → F k x ≤ F k y) →
    (∀ (k x : Nat), F (k + 1) (F (k + 1) x) = F k x) → (∀ (x : Nat), x < F 0 x) → False

name: FractionalPowerset.flat_madd_iff_flat_mul
type:
∀ {C : Type} (add mul : C → C → C) (le : C → C → Prop),
  (∀ (a b : C), le a b → le b a → a = b) →
    ∀ (two : C),
      (∀ (m : C), mul m two = add m m) →
        (∀ (m a b : C), le a b → le (mul m a) (mul m b)) →
          (∀ (a b : C), le a (add a b)) →
            (∀ (a b : C), add a b = add b a) →
              ∀ (m : C), le two m → le m (mul m m) → (add (add m m) (mul m m) = m ↔ mul m m = m)

name: MultAdd.JetFields.cayley_hamilton
type:
∀ {R : Type} [inst : Grind.CommRing R] (X : MultAdd.JetFields.M3 R),
  have X2 := X.mul X;
  have X3 := X.mul X2;
  X3.m11 - X.tr * X2.m11 + X.e2 * X.m11 - X.det = 0 ∧
    X3.m12 - X.tr * X2.m12 + X.e2 * X.m12 = 0 ∧
      X3.m13 - X.tr * X2.m13 + X.e2 * X.m13 = 0 ∧
        X3.m21 - X.tr * X2.m21 + X.e2 * X.m21 = 0 ∧
          X3.m22 - X.tr * X2.m22 + X.e2 * X.m22 - X.det = 0 ∧
            X3.m23 - X.tr * X2.m23 + X.e2 * X.m23 = 0 ∧
              X3.m31 - X.tr * X2.m31 + X.e2 * X.m31 = 0 ∧
                X3.m32 - X.tr * X2.m32 + X.e2 * X.m32 = 0 ∧ X3.m33 - X.tr * X2.m33 + X.e2 * X.m33 - X.det = 0

type:

LinearAlgebraMA.M2.smul (1 - q * a * b)

  FractalBoxes.join3Layer (1 / 3) (1 / 3) (1 / 3) 1 = 1 ∧
    FractalBoxes.join3Layer (1 / 3) (1 / 3) (1 / 3) 2 = 0 ∧
      FractalBoxes.join3Layer (1 / 3) (1 / 3) (1 / 3) 3 = 0 ∧
        FractalBoxes.join3Layer (1 / 3) (1 / 3) (1 / 3) 4 = 0 ∧ FractalBoxes.join3Layer (1 / 3) (1 / 3) (1 / 3) 5 = 0

name: FractalBoxes.half_layers
type:
FractalBoxes.layer (1 / 2) 0 = 1 ∧
  FractalBoxes.layer (1 / 2) 1 = 1 / 2 ∧
    FractalBoxes.layer (1 / 2) 2 = -1 / 8 ∧
      FractalBoxes.layer (1 / 2) 3 = 1 / 16 ∧
        FractalBoxes.layer (1 / 2) 4 = -5 / 128 ∧
          FractalBoxes.layer (1 / 2) 5 = 7 / 256 ∧ FractalBoxes.layer (1 / 2) 6 = -21 / 1024

name: FractalBoxes.cube_layers
type:
FractalBoxes.layer 3 0 = 1 ∧
  FractalBoxes.layer 3 1 = 3 ∧ FractalBoxes.layer 3 2 = 3 ∧ FractalBoxes.layer 3 3 = 1 ∧ FractalBoxes.layer 3 4 = 0

name: FractalBoxes.half_and_three_halves
type:
FractalBoxes.joinLayer (1 / 2) (3 / 2) 0 = 1 ∧
  FractalBoxes.joinLayer (1 / 2) (3 / 2) 1 = 2 ∧
    FractalBoxes.joinLayer (1 / 2) (3 / 2) 2 = 1 ∧
      FractalBoxes.joinLayer (1 / 2) (3 / 2) 3 = 0 ∧ FractalBoxes.joinLayer (1 / 2) (3 / 2) 4 = 0

name: FractalBoxes.no_affine_half_pow2
type: ∀ (c e : Nat), ¬∀ (d : Nat), c * (c * d + e) + e = 2 ^ d

name: FractalBoxes.pieces_join
type: ∀ (N M m : Nat), (N * M) ^ m = N ^ m * M ^ m

name: FractalBoxes.code_inj
type:
∀ (B : Nat),
  2 ≤ B → ∀ (bs cs : List Bool), bs.length = cs.length → FractalBoxes.code B bs = FractalBoxes.code B cs → bs = cs

name: FractalBoxes.no_linear_half_pow2
type: ∀ (Φ : Nat → Nat) (A B : Nat), (∀ (d : Nat), Φ d ≤ A * d + B) → ¬∀ (d : Nat), Φ (Φ d) = 2 ^ d

name: FractalBoxes.half_join_stick
type:
FractalBoxes.joinLayer (1 / 2) (1 / 2) 0 = 1 ∧
  FractalBoxes.joinLayer (1 / 2) (1 / 2) 1 = 1 ∧ ∀ (k : Nat), k < 9 → FractalBoxes.joinLayer (1 / 2) (1 / 2) (k + 2) = 0

name: FractalBoxes.code_lt
type: ∀ (B : Nat), 2 ≤ B → ∀ (bs : List Bool), FractalBoxes.code B bs < B ^ bs.length

name: FractalDials.mulAdd_shift
type: ∀ (x y : Int), FractalDials.mulAdd (x - 1) (y - 1) = x * y - 1

name: FractalDials.pieces_join_closed
type: ∀ (c b c' b' n : Nat), c * b ^ n * (c' * b' ^ n) = c * c' * (b * b') ^ n

name: FractalDials.gasket_touches
type: ∀ (m : Nat), 0 < m → FractalDials.gasketVertices m < 3 * 3 ^ m

name: FractalDials.gasket_vertices
type: ∀ (m : Nat), 2 * FractalDials.gasketVertices m = 3 ^ (m + 1) + 3

name: FractalDials.powerset_not_selfsimilar
type: ¬∃ c b, ∀ (n : Nat), 2 ^ 2 ^ n = c * b ^ n

name: FractalDials.mulAdd_identity
type: ∀ (a : Int), FractalDials.mulAdd a 0 = a ∧ FractalDials.mulAdd 0 a = a

name: FractalDials.dyadic_glue
type: FractalDials.sumR (List.map (fun i => 1 / 2 ^ (i + 2)) (List.range 39)) + 1 / 2 ^ 40 = 1 / 2

name: DialPotential.dial_rescale
type:
∀ {R : Type} [inst : Grind.CommRing R] (k k' s a b : R),
  k' * s = k → MultAdd.wAdd k' (s * a) (s * b) = s * MultAdd.wAdd k a b

name: DialPotential.well_one_two
type: DialPotential.well 1 (2 * 1) = 9

name: DialPotential.multAdd_mirror
type: ∀ {R : Type} [inst : Grind.CommRing R] (k : R), MultAdd.multAdd k (-k) = -(k * k)

name: DialPotential.quartic_mass
type:
∀ (lam v x : Rat),
  lam / 4 * (((v + x) * (v + x) - v * v) * ((v + x) * (v + x) - v * v)) =
    1 / 2 * (2 * lam * (v * v)) * (x * x) + lam * v * (x * x * x) + lam / 4 * (x * x * x * x)

name: DialPotential.well_even
type: ∀ {R : Type} [inst : Grind.CommRing R] (k0 k : R), DialPotential.well k0 (-k) = DialPotential.well k0 k

name: DialPotential.scale_covariant_is_power
type: ∀ (V : Rat → Rat) (n : Nat), (∀ (s k : Rat), V (s * k) = s ^ n * V k) → ∀ (k : Rat), V k = V 1 * k ^ n

name: DialPotential.well_dips
type: ∀ {R : Type} [inst : Grind.CommRing R] (k0 : R), DialPotential.well k0 k0 = 0 ∧ DialPotential.well k0 (-k0) = 0

name: DialPotential.dial_flip
type: ∀ {R : Type} [inst : Grind.CommRing R] (k a b : R), MultAdd.wAdd (-k) a b = -MultAdd.wAdd k (-a) (-b)

name: DialPotential.well_breaks_scale
type: ∀ (n : Nat), ¬∀ (s k : Rat), DialPotential.well 1 (s * k) = s ^ n * DialPotential.well 1 k

name: DialPotential.well_hump
type: ∀ {R : Type} [inst : Grind.CommRing R] (k0 : R), DialPotential.well k0 0 = k0 * k0 * (k0 * k0)

name: DialPotential.dial_zero
type: ∀ {R : Type} [inst : Grind.CommRing R] (a b : R), MultAdd.wAdd 0 a b = a + b

name: DialPotential.well_eq
type: ∀ {R : Type} [inst : Grind.CommRing R] (k0 k : R), DialPotential.well k0 k = (k0 * k0 - k * k) * (k0 * k0 - k * k)

name: DialPotential.well_at_dip
type:
∀ {R : Type} [inst : Grind.CommRing R] (k0 h : R),
  DialPotential.well k0 (k0 + h) = 4 * k0 * k0 * (h * h) + 4 * k0 * (h * h * h) + h * h * h * h

name: DialPotential.well_one_one
type: DialPotential.well 1 1 = 0
